title: Case 010: Refund visible in the account
initial_request: I can see my outgoing transfer to Northmere Home Supplies in my secure portal. The supplier told me it might return the £42.80, but I cannot tell whether that specific refund has reached my account. Please check the incoming entries and confirm its status.
overview: Elowen Marr escalated a query about a possible refund for her £42.80 transfer to Northmere Home Supplies. H&V checked the account's incoming entries and confirmed that the matching refund was credited. The reason the original payment was declined was not established.

next_action.summary: Check H&V's incoming-entry journal for a refund matching the customer's outgoing transfer to Northmere Home Supplies.

outcome: H&V confirmed that the matching £42.80 refund is credited to the customer's account. The reason the original payment was declined remains unestablished.

events.body: Outgoing transfer — Northmere Home Supplies — £42.80 — shown in account history.

I am escalating this because Northmere Home Supplies said the £42.80 might be returned. Please check whether the incoming entry is for that specific transfer; I do not want it confused with another payment.
I am checking the linked incoming entries on Elowen Marr's account for a £42.80 refund matching the Northmere Home Supplies transfer. I will not treat a similar-looking entry as a match.
The incoming-entry record shows a £42.80 credit identified as the refund for the Northmere Home Supplies transfer in the account history.
Refund status: £42.80 credited to your account. This credit matches the Northmere Home Supplies transfer shown in your account history.
